Jennifer Lawrence Confirms Emotional Return as Katniss Everdeen in 'The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping'

29 Oct 2026, 11:26 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Entertainment Desk · Source: deadline.com

Key takeawaysJennifer Lawrence has confirmed that she will reprise her iconic role as Katniss Everdeen in the upcoming movie adaptation of Suzanne Collins' *The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping*. The actress shared details of her return during an appearance on the *Call Her Dadd

Jennifer Lawrence has confirmed that she will reprise her iconic role as Katniss Everdeen in the upcoming movie adaptation of Suzanne Collins' The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping. The actress shared details of her return during an appearance on the Call Her Daddy podcast.

Reunion With Co-Stars and Crew

During her interview, Lawrence discussed reuniting with former co-stars Josh Hutcherson and Woody Harrelson for the prequel film. Describing the experience as deeply emotional, Lawrence noted that she and Hutcherson remained inseparable during production, while playfully recounting how Harrelson bypassed hotel boundaries in his usual fashion.

Lawrence also highlighted the emotional resonance of working alongside many members of the original crew, calling the overall experience "unbelievable" and "crazy."

Story and Background

The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping is directed by Francis Lawrence from a screenplay by Billy Ray and Michael Lesslie, adapting Suzanne Collins' novel. The story is set in Panem 24 years before the events of the original Hunger Games trilogy, focusing on the 50th Annual Hunger Games—the Second Quarter Quell—which features twice as many tributes.

The narrative centers on a sixteen-year-old Haymitch Abernathy, played by Joseph Zada, from District 12. As the arena events unfold, Haymitch forms an alliance with fellow tribute Maysilee Donner (Mckenna Grace) and joins a coalition aiming to challenge the Capitol's control under President Snow, portrayed by Ralph Fiennes. The wider cast includes Jesse Plemons, Glenn Close, Kieran Culkin, Elle Fanning, Maya Hawke, Whitney Peak, Kelvin Harrison Jr., and Ben Wang.

Practical Implications and Reader Verification

The film is scheduled to open in theaters on November 20, 2026. Readers interested in verifying these details can review the original coverage and watch the interview excerpts on [Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/10/jennifer-lawrence-reprising-hunger-games-sunrise-on-the-reaping-1237207102/).

Confirmed Versus Unknown

  • Confirmed: Jennifer Lawrence, Josh Hutcherson, and Woody Harrelson are reprising their roles. Francis Lawrence is directing, and the theatrical release is slated for November 20, 2026. The plot focuses on a young Haymitch Abernathy during the 50th Annual Hunger Games.
  • Unknown: Specific plot points beyond the primary premise and exact promotional rollout schedules remain undisclosed outside of official studio announcements.
